title: Rising Temperature
description: Find the record_date of all dates where the temperature was higher than the previous day. Return a single column named record_date.
solutionQuery: WITH PrevWeather AS (SELECT record_date, temperature, LAG(temperature, 1) OVER (ORDER BY record_date ASC) AS prev_temp FROM Weather) SELECT record_date FROM PrevWeather WHERE prev_temp IS NOT NULL AND temperature > prev_temp;
explanation: Use LAG(temperature, 1) OVER (ORDER BY record_date ASC) to access the preceding day's temperature and filter where current temperature exceeds it.
